purpose: Prospective before-outcome architecture comparison responding to user priority; not replacement of historical Q1 gates
optimizer: Adam betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, zero weight decay
initialization: explicit per-arm source pin and deterministic seed; candidate begins at constant angular velocity
fit_sampler: PCG64 default_rng(SeedSequence([training_seed,fold_id])) uniform global fit origins with replacement, paired across all arms
candidate_schedule: 3 folds x 2 seeds x 3 arms = 18 fits; 5000 updates each; 100-update prefix may be resumed only from verified matching full-state checkpoint
validation: same frozen full user-disjoint origins and outcome safeguards as protocol v5; no old development/final signals
classical_reference: fit-only selection from competence-validated frozen candidate grid; limited to that grid
scientific_interpretation: Incremental full-recipe advantage only; no unproven reliability, novelty or effective-capacity attribution
required_prelaunch: exact model factory and input bindings
correct scoped provider, root authority and watchdog
fixed budget live ledger with 150s historical debit and 1800s reserve
full-path FP32 ONNX parity and CPU timing
separate root lock for new protocol before any outcomes
user_full_goal: All original Moonshot v2 thresholds, holdouts, independent evaluation, 10 seeds, lawful transfer and deployment remain unchanged
cost_policy: Before $16 total incurred/committed or projected final charges, stop launching paid compute and preserve/export checkpoints; $4 is reserved for necessary outstanding fees, storage, transfer or recovery, not discretionary training. Total limit $20 across all providers/fees. Actual provider spending-limit enforcement, billing delay and worst-case exposure must be verified; no cloud access or spend is authorized by this draft alone.
deferred_ablation: Finite same-feature vector comparator and single-exponential composition control are deferred. This screen cannot isolate superiority over all same-feature readouts or claim product composition benefit. Any later comparison needs separate prospective lock and explicit funding within cap.
cost_savings_scope: 90000 versus 120000 updates in four-arm draft: 25 percent fewer updates; versus 150000 in five-arm draft: 40 percent fewer. Actual total hours and dollars depend on model speed, startup, data, validation, retries and fees, and have not been measured.
staged_execution: First run a bounded fit-only pilot to measure loss, throughput and cost without validation outcomes. Continue to the prespecified 18-fit comparison only after resource projection and gates. Do not modify arms or thresholds using observed evaluation outcomes.
final_evidence: All original objective requirements remain intact, including at least ten training seeds for the candidate, fair strongest comparator, unchanged origins and holdouts, independent evaluation, uncertainty, tails, licensed transfer and deployment. Feasibility within $20 is unknown.
three_arm_rationale: Keep one ordered-motion candidate, active order ablation, and contemporaneously trained raw neural comparator, plus fairly tuned classical reference; compare all arms using the same folds and schedules.
